create or alter view [dbo].[FollowDetail] as with ArtifactTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on F.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class in (1,8) where F.AssetTypeID is not null and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType ATT on P.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID and Att.Class in (1,8) inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeID is not null ), DomainTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetID, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = F.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 9 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeId is not null ), Groups as ( select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetId, P.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = P.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 12 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID inner join [Group] C on C.ID = A.SourceID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeId is not null ), PolicyTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeId from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = F.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 6 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeId is not null union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = P.AssetTypeID and Att.Class = 6 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID Where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeId is not null ), PolicyParents as ( select F.ID as FollowID, null as ParentID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, cast(Null as bigint) ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join Asset A on F.AssetID = A.ID inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 6 left join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 where I.IntersectID is null and F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetID is Not Null union all select P.FollowID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Asset A inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 6 inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join PolicyParents p on I.SubjectAssetID = p.AssetID ), Resources as ( select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID as AssetID, P.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = P.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 11 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeId = Att.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource C on C.ResourceID = A.SourceID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeId Is Not Null and C.ResourceID > 0 ), TaxonomyParents as ( select F.ID as FollowID, null as ParentID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, cast(Null as bigint) ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join Asset A on F.AssetID = A.ID inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 2 left join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 where I.IntersectID is null and F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetID is Not Null union all select P.FollowID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Asset A inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 2 inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join PolicyParents p on I.SubjectAssetID = p.AssetID ), TaxonomyTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on F.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 2 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeID is not null union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on P.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 2 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeID is not null ), RuleTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on F.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 7 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeID is not null union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on P.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 7 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeID is not null )
select F.FollowID, F.ResourceID, R.Email, R.Email as FollowerEmail, R.FirstName + ' ' + R.LastName as FollowerName, R.FirstName as FollowerFirstName, R.LastName as FollowerLastName, 'Resource' as FollowerObjectType, F.ResourceID as FollowerObjectID, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl((select A.ID from Asset A inner join AssetType att on att.id = a.assettypeid and att.class = 11 where A.SourceID = F.ResourceID)) as FollowerUrl, A.ID as AssetID, coalesce(F.AssetID,F.AssetTypeID) as ID, coalesce(AName.DisplayValue,OAT.Name) Name, coalesce(AName.DisplayValue,OAT.Name) TextPath, cast(null as nvarchar) Description, cast(null as int) ParentID, cast(null as varchar) ParentType, coalesce(AUrl.Url,ATUrl.Url) as Url, case coalesce(AAT.Class,OAT.Class) when 11 then 'User' when 12 then 'Group' else AAT.Name end as [TypeName], coalesce(AATS.IconBackColor,OATS.IconBackColor,'#000') IconBackColor, coalesce(AATS.IconForeColor,OATS.IconForeColor, '#fff') IconForeColor, coalesce(AATS.IconText, OATS.IconText , 'leaf') IconText, 0 AS OpenEventCount, cast(S.Value as decimal(4,3)) as CurrentScore, cast(F.HardFollow as bit) as HardFollow, coalesce(AAT.ID,OAT.ID) AssetTypeID from ( select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from ArtifactTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow , AssetID, AssetTypeID from DomainTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from Groups union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from PolicyTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from PolicyParents union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from Resources union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from TaxonomyParents union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from TaxonomyTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from RuleTypes union select ID as FollowID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from Follow where FollowTypeID = 1 ) F inner join reporting.Global_Resource R on R.ResourceID = F.ResourceID left join Asset A on A.ID = F.AssetID and F.AssetID is not null left join AssetType AAT on AAT.ID = A.AssetTypeID left join AssetTypeStyle AATS on AATS.ID = AAT.ID outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueById](A.ID) AName outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetUrlById](A.ID) AUrl left Outer Join AssetType OAT on OAT.ID = F.AssetTypeID and F.AssetID is null left join AssetTypeStyle OATS on OATS.ID = OAT.ID outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlByID](OAT.ID) ATUrl outer apply ( select S.Value from metrics.Score S inner join metrics.Allocation Al on Al.Uid = S.AllocationUid and Al.ScoreType = 1 and Al.OverrideName is null and S.AssetUid = A.[Uid] and S.EffectiveDate <= getutcdate() and (S.EndDate >= getutcdate() or S.EndDate is null) ) S where (A.ID IS NOT NULL OR OAT.ID IS NOT NULL)

create or alter view [dbo].[FollowDetail] as with ArtifactTypes as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'ArtifactType' and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, cast('Artifact' as varchar(50)) as [Object], A.ObjectID as ObjectID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from Asset A inner join AssetType ATT on A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID and A.[Object] = 'Artifact' inner join Follow P on P.ObjectType = 'ArtifactType' and P.ObjectID = ATT.ObjectID and P.FollowTypeID = 3 ), DomainTypes as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'ReferenceItemType' and FollowTypeID = 3 ), Groups as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'Group' and ObjectID = 0 and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ObjectType as [Object], C.ID as ObjectID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from [Group] C inner join Follow P on P.ObjectType = 'Group' and P.ObjectID = 0 and P.FollowTypeID = 3 ), PolicyTypes as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'PolicyType' and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, cast('Policy' as varchar(50)) as [Object], A.ObjectID as ObjectID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from Asset A inner join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.[Object] = 'Policy' inner join Follow P on P.ObjectType = 'PolicyType' and P.ObjectID = ATT.ObjectID and P.FollowTypeID = 3 ), PolicyParents as ( select F.ID as FollowID, T.ObjectID as ID, null as ParentID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from AssetDetail T left join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = 'Policy' and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join Follow F on F.ObjectType = 'Policy' and F.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and F.FollowTypeID = 3 where I.IntersectID is null and T.Object = 'Policy' union all select P.FollowID, T.ObjectID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from AssetDetail T inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = 'Policy' and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join PolicyParents p on I.Subject = 'Policy' and I.SubjectID = p.ID where T.Object = 'Policy' ), Resources as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'ResourceType' and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, cast('Resource' as varchar(50)) as [Object], C.ResourceID as ObjectID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from reporting.Global_Resource C inner join Follow P on P.ObjectType = 'ResourceType' and P.FollowTypeID = 3 where C.ResourceID > 0 ), TaxonomyParents as ( select F.ID as FollowID, T.ObjectID as ID, null as ParentID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from AssetDetail T left join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = 'Taxonomy' and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join Follow F on F.ObjectType = 'Taxonomy' and F.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and F.FollowTypeID = 3 where I.IntersectID is null and T.Object = 'Taxonomy' union all select P.FollowID, T.ObjectID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from AssetDetail T inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = 'Taxonomy' and I.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join TaxonomyParents p on I.Subject = 'Taxonomy' and I.SubjectID = p.ID where T.Object = 'Taxonomy' ), TaxonomyTypes as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'TaxonomyType' and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, cast('Taxonomy' as varchar(50)) as [Object], A.ObjectID as ObjectID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from Asset A inner join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.[Object] = 'Taxonomy' inner join Follow P on P.ObjectType = 'TaxonomyType' and P.ObjectID = ATT.ObjectID and P.FollowTypeID = 3 ), RuleTypes as ( select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where ObjectType = 'RuleType' and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, cast('Rule' as varchar(50)) as [Object], A.ObjectID as ObjectID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow from Asset A inner join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.[Object] = 'Rule' inner join Follow P on P.ObjectType = 'RuleType' and P.ObjectID = ATT.ObjectID and P.FollowTypeID = 3 )
select F.FollowID, F.ResourceID, R.Email, R.Email as FollowerEmail, R.FirstName + ' ' + R.LastName as FollowerName, R.FirstName as FollowerFirstName, R.LastName as FollowerLastName, 'Resource' as FollowerObjectType, F.ResourceID as FollowerObjectID, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl((select ID from Asset where Object ='Resource' and ObjectID = F.ResourceID)) as FollowerUrl, F.ObjectID, F.[Object] as ObjectType, A.ID as AssetID, O.ObjectID as ID, O.Name, O.TextPath, O.Description, O.ParentID, O.Parent as ParentType, O.Url, O.ObjectTypeID as TypeID, O.ObjectType as [Type], case O.ObjectType when 'ResourceType' then 'User' when 'Group' then 'Group' else O.ObjectTypeName end as [TypeName], O.IconBackColor, O.IconForeColor, O.IconText, 0 AS OpenEventCount, cast(S.Value as decimal(4,3)) as CurrentScore, cast(F.HardFollow as bit) as HardFollow from ( select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from ArtifactTypes union select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from DomainTypes union select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from Groups union select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from PolicyTypes union select FollowID, 'Policy', ID as ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from PolicyParents union select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from Resources union select FollowID, 'Taxonomy' as [Object], ID as ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from TaxonomyParents union select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from TaxonomyTypes union select FollowID, [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, HardFollow from RuleTypes union select ID as FollowID, ObjectType as [Object], ObjectID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow from Follow where FollowTypeID = 1 ) F inner join reporting.Global_Resource R on R.ResourceID = F.ResourceID inner join cache.ObjectDetails O on O.[Object] = F.[Object] and O.ObjectID = F.ObjectID left join Asset A on A.Object = F.Object and A.ObjectID = F.ObjectID outer apply ( select S.Value from metrics.Score S inner join metrics.Allocation Al on Al.Uid = S.AllocationUid and Al.ScoreType = 1 and Al.OverrideName is null and S.AssetUid = A.[Uid] and S.EffectiveDate <= getutcdate() and (S.EndDate >= getutcdate() or S.EndDate is null) ) S
